parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the window, RFC 3339.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the window, RFC 3339. Must be strictly after `from`.

parameters.name: taskType
parameters.description: Optional exact-match filter. Omit for every task type; pass `UNCLASSIFIED` to select only the unclassified bucket.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Bucket resolution. Only hourly buckets are modelled in this round.
